notes: The operation returns one stored source-selected trajectory revision and never performs hidden multi-source fusion.
Every interval, tracklet, finalization, watermark, profile, and analysis-space input is frozen by the returned snapshot or its HISTORY_INPUT_SET resource.
When no as-of revision or outcome exists, the Provider only idempotently enqueues the exact frozen request and returns PROJECTION_PENDING; construction remains worker-owned.

history.get-trajectory@1.0.rationale: The preview provider performs scoped, head-free reads of immutable trajectory revisions and their complete persisted lineage. A missing result can cause only a bounded, scope-checked enqueue of the exact effective snapshot; source selection and trajectory construction remain worker projection-owned.
